title: Microsoft Office SharePoint Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability

descriptions.value: In _vqueue_get_avail_buf_locked of trusty/kernel/lib/trusty/vqueue.c, there is a possible Double-read / TOCTOU due to a race condition. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with execution privileges needed. User interaction is for exploitation.

In cpm_mbox_power_ctrl_sswrp of cpm_mbox.c, there is a possible permission bypass due to a precondition check failure. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with System execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
